profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at 7 Oaks Group

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on a variety of projects. Doing backends in both Scala and Java. The Java resource servers are on spring boot. Scala is running on the Http4s framework. A variety of frontends using Vue or React. An authorization server written in Javascript on Node. Running Kafka, using jdbc connectors and Avro schemas. Creating connectors and custom producer and consumers. Involved in planning and design of systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Being a part of a super small company allows me to truly be a full stack developer. Here is a quick list of things I work on.
- AWS  = EC2, EC2 Containers, Route 53, RDS, VPC, Clusters, auto-scaling.
- Docker = a big chunk of the AWS was containerizing all our apps and making it into a continuous integration. I also created a base image to use for all our projects. 
- BASH plus other linux tools
- Angular 
- ReactJS
- Services are all using SpringBoot projects with Maven and Java

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Design and develop large scale multi-national web system using SAP Hybris. 
Troubleshoot and develop the Datahub system used by Hybris.
Create enhanced queries for better searching using Solr. 
Hybris uses a modular spring integration framework that builds using Apache Ant all written in Java.
Database is Hana. Use flexibleSearch queries.
All projects run on Tomcat.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently building a project using ReactJs with Node, Spring boot, written in Java, and Oracle DB with Datomic running on top. Also using Awk and Bash to do filing. 
And Using SamTools to read Genetic files.
Update legacy apps to use REST services.
Create new security process using the VASCO Digipass. 
Create SOAP calls using given WSDL files.
Create Hibernate and Native queries.
Use Java, Jquery, jquery datatables, maven, Spring, mockito, Ajax, XML, bash, Awk, Samtools, Angular, ReactJs, Springboot, Sql Develepment, and etc...

positions.title: QA Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Create automated tests using Selenium, TestNG, Maven, and written with Java.
Setup Automated framework.
Automate tests for Ipad and Iphone using ios-driver.
ITIL foundations certified.
